identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime][bug] Make A2A action selection reliable for model-backed agents

values.task_boundary: Repair only the brittle model-output-to-governed-A2A action selection boundary introduced after #662 and #675.
deliverables: reliable first-class A2A action selection boundary
governed dispatch integration preserving existing authority
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Production conversation ingress selects A2A from ordinary model-style output without requiring perfect JSON.
AC-2: Runtime constructs and validates the governed initiation with canonical sender recipient work conversation turn and correlation identity.
AC-3: Recipient executes through its configured provider route and the correlated terminal result is distinct from the initiator's operator reply.
AC-4: Authoritative Observatory/feed activity exposes initiation dispatch and result.
AC-5: Missing or stale recipient unauthorized sender replay cancellation and provider failure retain explicit governed outcomes.
AC-6: Isolated production-ingress live-style proof passes repeatedly with non-perfect model output.
AC-7: Existing #662 primitive and compatible #675 tests remain green.
AC-8: Focused validation diff hygiene and independent exact-head review pass before non-draft publication.
non_goals: Live Wuji restart or config mutation
